text:
mira: quick sync on derived-token TTL semantics when proxying. options: inherit (clamped), fresh-fixed, or route-opt-in.
dan: prefer inherit_clamped + org_max cap. fewer surprises and cheaper. add explicit reject on role-expansion.
hao: agree but rollout reject-first. silent truncation can break jobs. default should surface failures.
sylvie: verifier must enforce caps too (not just issuer). include parent_id and issued_expiry in claims to check chain offline.
ops-bot: infra note: token cache key must include parent_id, route_id, mode.
mira: migration plan: 1) opt-in inherit_clamped + reject_on_expand 2) after metrics stable, switch to clamp+truncate with warnings 3) add admin extension flow for long-lived needs.
dan: telemetry: emit derived.issue, derived.reject.role_expand, avg_derived_ttl, lineage.depth.
hao: ACTIONS: dan draft RFC by Fri; sylvie audit routes for expansions by Tue; ops-bot to open infra ticket for cache + telemetry.
mira: thanks — will link RFC when ready. :rocket:
